facts.why: Rico throws the steak at Napoleon while Napoleon rides past on his bike, then sits back down on the porch and spits a bite into his hand. It is not thrown from a van.

facts.text: Uncle Rico ate all the steak, so I've got a plate of tots. I'm hiding some in my pocket for later.
facts.why: Not Napoleon's real dialogue, and no source I opened shows Rico eating all the steak or Napoleon with a plate of tots. The pocket tots and the kids begging for them are real.
facts.fix: Heck no, go find your own. I'm saving some tots in my pocket for later.
